classReports.title: Class Report — 28 Apr 2026
classReports.summary: A personalized lesson connecting fast fashion, Disney technology, authentic listening and speaking. Laura explained environmental ideas, described attractions and worked with passive voice.
classReports.teacherInsight: The strongest B2-facing need is to sustain explanations with more precision and understand authentic audio with less support.

classReports.title: Class Report — 12 May 2026
classReports.summary: A lesson on relationships, statistics and relative clauses. Laura interpreted data, discussed abstract vocabulary and practiced who/that to connect ideas.
classReports.teacherInsight: Laura participates well in reading and interpretation; relative clauses should be recycled in her own production to verify autonomy.

classReports.title: Class Report — 22 May 2026
classReports.summary: A lesson on preferences, social media, spend/waste and colour idioms, with spontaneous opinions and contextual interpretation.
classReports.teacherInsight: Laura produces spontaneous opinions and negotiates meaning; lexical precision and fluency remain key B2-facing development areas.

grammarOverview.title: Grammar & Accuracy Overview
grammarOverview.summary: Laura's B1→B2 path focuses on using known structures more independently and accurately inside longer communication.
focusPoints: Relative clauses: consolidate who/that in more complex sentences.
Passive voice: practice be + past participle in meaningful technology and academic contexts.
Accuracy in extended speech: reduce tense, article and word-choice errors while maintaining fluency.

teacherFeedback.title: General Feedback
teacherFeedback.body: Laura communicates willingly and can discuss school, travel, technology and personal opinions in English. Her B1 profile supports meaningful communication, while complex explanations still benefit from time, prompting and reformulation.

teacherFeedback.title: Growth Priority
teacherFeedback.body: The B2 pathway should prioritize longer connected answers, more independent listening and more precise grammar and vocabulary so Laura can maintain quality when the topic becomes less familiar.
